mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment which may affect tamoxifen metabolism and increase risk of QT prolongation, particularly relevant given tamoxifen's own cardiac effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes, renal function, and ECG regularly; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider ECG baseline and periodic monitoring given both agents' potential cardiac effects.
